timeline.evidenceText: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.

definitions.full: H8344. Sheshay שֵׁשַׁי proper name, masculine a son of Anak (Aramaic form, compare GFM Ju ); — Num 13:22 ; Josh 15:14 (both J E), Judg 1:10 ; Σες ( ς ) ει , Σουσαι , Σουσει . שִׁשִּׁית שִׁשִּׁים, שִׁשִּׁי, see שֵׁשׁ below שׁדשׁ .
